normalize_text: normalize text by lowercasing, stripping accents, replacing digits, and handling unicode punctuation
normalize_for_dedup_text: normalize text for deduplication by lowercasing, replacing digits with 0, and removing punctuation
normalize_spacing_for_tok_text: normalize spacing in text for tokenization with language-specific punctuation and quote handling
strip_accents_text: strip diacritical accents from text using NFD unicode normalization
replace_unicode_punct_text: replace unicode punctuation characters with their ASCII equivalents in text
